lines.text: Do you know how the codes in Google Authenticator work, even with no signal?
Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, they all make a new code every thirty seconds. The website somehow knows it too. And they never talk!
When you scanned that QR code, your phone and the website got the same secret key. Just once.
Now both sides take that secret, plus the time, rounded to thirty seconds.
They drop both into the same mathematical blender, and keep six digits of what comes out.
Same secret, same time, same blender. Same six digits! Nothing had to be sent.
And if someone peeks at your code? Thirty seconds later, it's useless.
Orbi Transfer keeps a secret the same way. Your passcode never leaves your phone. Only locked pieces travel.
